name: 55041 · Lake City, MN
findings: ZIP 55041 (Lake City) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55041 (Lake City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
65% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55041 (Lake City) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 78% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
